scope: Review-only candidate Template bound to the exact existing gallery Artwork; eight complete-character recipes with explicit ready-pose-to-held-prop path. Generated branches are preview-only and not approved.

descriptionByLanguage.en: An original chibi person with a high chestnut bun and loose strands, a warm-yellow hoodie, ivory shorts and yellow-white shoes, waving with one raised hand.
descriptionByLanguage.zh-CN: 原创栗色高丸子头 Q 版人物，穿暖黄色连帽衫、米白短裤和黄白鞋，抬手挥别。

artApproval.scope: Existing gallery source remains unchanged; only the new Template and generated branches are pending review.
Review-only full-character v3 branches for ready-to-hold pose and held prop; does not approve or replace the existing Artwork.

identitySemanticsByLanguage.en: One original chibi person. Preserve the same individual, facial identity, skin tone, age impression, body proportions and hand count. The original pose, hand placement, hair arrangement, garment color, expression, clothing and accessories may change only when the selected registered option explicitly names that change. Keep the complete person in a single transparent PNG; do not add another character, typography or a scene.
identitySemanticsByLanguage.zh-CN: 单个原创 Q 版人物。保持同一人物、面部身份、肤色、年龄感、身体比例和手部数量。原始姿势、手部位置、发型整理、衣料配色、表情、衣着和配饰，只有在所选注册选项明确说明时才允许改变。完整人物保留在单张透明 PNG 中；不得增加其他人物、文字或场景。

semanticByLanguage.en: the original hairstyle and hair color; preserve the face, body scale, pose and outfit
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 保留原有发型和发色，脸、体型比例、姿势与衣着不变

semanticByLanguage.en: the same person with hair arranged into two balanced buns; preserve face, waving gesture, outfit and shoes
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 同一人物，头发整理为对称双丸子头；保留脸、挥手手势、衣服和鞋子

semanticByLanguage.en: the same girl standing upright with the same legs, high chestnut bun, face, warm-yellow hoodie, ivory shorts and yellow-white shoes; lower the waving arm and bring both forearms forward to chest height, with relaxed hands open around a small empty grip space; this option contains no camera
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 同一女孩保持直立站姿、双腿姿势、高栗色丸子头、面容、暖黄色连帽衫、米白短裤和黄白鞋不变；放下挥手的手臂并将双前臂调整到胸前高度，双手放松、围出一处空的握持空间；此选项不含相机

semanticByLanguage.en: the original warm-yellow hoodie color; preserve skin, hair and all other garment zones
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 保留原有暖黄色连帽衫配色；肤色、头发和其他衣物区域不变

semanticByLanguage.en: only the hoodie changes to soft lavender; preserve skin, chestnut hair, shorts, shoes and waving pose
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 仅连帽衫改为柔和薰衣草紫；保留肤色、栗色头发、短裤、鞋和挥手姿势

semanticByLanguage.en: the original open eyes and gentle smile
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 保留原有睁眼与柔和微笑

semanticByLanguage.en: two matching gentle closed eyes; preserve the original smile, face shape, high-bun hairstyle, outfit and waving pose
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 两只对称柔和的闭合眼睛；保留原有微笑、脸型、高丸子头、衣着与挥手姿势

semanticByLanguage.en: the original outfit with its fit and natural hand occlusion
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 保留原有衣着、合身关系与手部自然遮挡

semanticByLanguage.en: a fitted coral pinafore over a light blouse; keep straps naturally on the shoulders, garment fitted to the torso and waving hand unobstructed
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 浅色上衣外穿合体珊瑚色背带裙；肩带自然落肩、裙身贴合躯干且不遮挡挥手

semanticByLanguage.en: one a small lavender flower clip attached naturally to the hair beside the high bun
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 固定在高丸子头旁发丝上的小巧薰衣草色花朵发夹

semanticByLanguage.en: one compact mirrorless camera held at chest height; the right hand grips the body near the shutter while the left hand visibly supports the lens from below, with natural contact and hand-camera occlusion; no floating strap or detached parts
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 一台在胸前高度手持的紧凑微单相机；右手握住靠近快门的机身，左手从下方清楚托住镜头，手与相机自然接触并有正确遮挡；肩带和部件不得悬浮或脱离
